title: CSV rerun ready classification
summary: Keep backend-remediable CSV rerun rows ready when their audit bucket is REVIEW, while preserving the bucket as evidence.
reason: CSV rerun preview was showing warning for subtitle/audio/video remediation rows solely because the audit export bucket was REVIEW, even though the backend rule could process them safely.
behavior_before: Subtitle/audio/video remediation rows with effective_bucket=REVIEW were marked warning because the review bucket added a non-blocking warning reason.
behavior_after: Subtitle/audio/video remediation rows with effective_bucket=REVIEW are marked ready when source/path/mode validation passes; stale backend-generated review-bucket warnings in scoped CSVs are normalized to ready.
rollback_plan: Revert src/mediapipeline/core/processes/rerun_rules.py and the focused test additions, then refresh the two generated summaries again.
notes:
Keep backend-remediable CSV rerun REVIEW rows ready instead of warning.
Add regression coverage for REVIEW bucket remediation rows staying ready.
Refresh generated summary after rerun preview regression tests.
